- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Notable breaches include the September 11 attacks on the World Trade Center and the Pentagon, the 2015 terror attacks on the Bardo Museum in Tunisia, the 2016 attack at Istanbul's Ataturk International Airport, and the 2018 terrorist attack at the Louvre Museum in Paris.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Security measures are continually updated and strengthened to prevent future breaches.
